tickets.description:
Planner-selected 75-minute experiment using only P_train/historically inspected takes0001,0002,0012. Pair complete original human takes with corresponding original verified canonical Panda feeding videos; no VIDEO10 goal-registered or display-warped outputs. Pin existing VIDEO03–07 full-image plus RGB-crop frozen encoder/preprocessing/fusion; raw robot views without held crosshair. At most128 actual timestamp-selected frames per stream, six scored primary streams. Source/representation gate15min; freeze up to18 agent-reviewed lift/arrival/release intervals by35min before viewing features/alignment; at least2 identifiable events per pair or retain unscorable. Run exactly TIME normalized elapsed progress, VISUAL monotone cosine-DTW, SHUFFLED one-second interior-human blocks seed161006 with endpoints fixed. No anchors, time/ID/truth/contact/action features or fitting. Score independent event-interval errors in robot seconds and duration fraction; mapped spans and collapse/stretch, reverse diagnostic and evidence sheets. Pass only if visual median improves both controls on>=2/3takes with no worst error worsening>5%clip duration. Nine outputs by55min; private report and verified Mint archive by75min. Zero dynamics, motor labels, optimizer updates, VLA calls, holdout changes or added controller authority.

Current operational hold, 2026-10-16: Not executed. Original07:01UTC clock exceeded before extraction; deviation preserved. Resumed09:06UTC for source inspection only. P_train roles, phone provenance/rotation and frozen descriptor code recovered; exact canonical feeding robot sources not yet reconciled. No new frames, labels, features, alignments, scores or rollouts. Nat then explicitly required storage coordination only and no new research. Execution remains on hold pending resumption; this is not a negative scientific result. Status evidence: https://github.com/NatMota/typhon-robotics/blob/e780a1652b70cd32bb80d000ad9d2db0ccda58fe/experiment-history/2026-10-16-data04-event-status/STATUS.md

OST reconciliation, 16 October evening: the supervisor completed a separately authorised EVAL36 panel and saved-trace audit (#11100/#11101). That exception did not resume DATA04 or the wider programme. DATA04 still has no extracted event labels, descriptor alignment outputs or scores. Remains Blocked / NOT RUN.

tickets.description:
Reconciled into the OST on 16 October 2026 from the supervisor's completed, separately user-authorised EVAL36 panel. This ticket records existing outcomes; it does not authorise a rerun or resume the broader programme.

Question: does frozen D5+C loading assistance improve complete feeding→loading workflows under a predeclared local simulator distribution?
Design: 36 scenario–seed draws paired across native N and assisted A; 72 completed workflows, 144 task stages. Two historically inspected source families (demo_0012/demo_0013, 22/14 actual draws), independent uniform ±5 mm X/Y and ±10° yaw perturbations. Fixed target/fixture, cameras, materials, controller and scorer. Same frozen GOAL and Q1 step3000 checkpoints as HIER02, supplied fixed-horizon stage switch, no resets/state injection between tasks, D5+C only in loading. No training/checkpoint selection or replacement draws.

Primary qualified success requires BOTH strict task endpoints plus zero recorded forbidden gripper/table-or-fixture contacts, nonnegative logged joint margin, and no failed or still-active assistance primitive.
Native: 25/36 (69.4%; exact 95% CI 51.9–83.7%).
Assisted: 31/36 (86.1%; exact 95% CI 70.5–95.3%).
Observed difference: +6/36, +16.7 percentage points. Paired outcomes: 24 both succeed; 7 assisted-only successes; 1 native-only success; 4 neither. Do not claim established statistical superiority.
Strict terminal outcomes alone: N 30/36, A 31/36. Engineering-qualified outcomes alone: N 30/36, A 35/36. These are distinct endpoints; primary is their intersection.

All 72 workflows completed; elapsed main panel 2534.57 seconds. All 144 stage scores exactly rescored. Follow-up trace audit independently reaggregated all 72 engineering/primary workflow flags with zero discrepancies. Draw024 has equal initial feeding states and noise but diverging feeding image inputs from query35; downstream loading boundaries differ. Retained without exclusion or rerun; cause unresolved.

Scope: conditional local simulator reliability, not unseen recording sessions, arbitrary task generalisation, numeral understanding or hardware safety. Previous HIER02 4/4 ceiling panel and INIT14 failures remain unchanged. Broader programme and DATA04 stay stalled.
